comment: Identity-gate baseline registry (refactor-policy rule 4). Stripped whole-image md5 of the ReleaseFast zjs, per build attractor. Update when main moves; a gate check builds the candidate once and compares against these instead of rebuilding the baseline.
notes: Both attractors measured identical on this tree (the historical bistability collapsed to one image here; earlier trees had two). Prior lineage: b325d7b1 = e93b69e8(incremental)/5df9578f(cold); naming-only = 223fc498/d43abd31; post-dedup = e2d49022.

protocol.incremental_converged: zig build zjs; touch src/internal_root.zig; zig build zjs; strip -o img zig-out/bin/zjs; md5sum img
protocol.cold_cache: copy tree without .zig-cache/zig-out, zig build zjs cold, strip, md5sum
